summary.en: AI helpers (summarize, smart-reply, smart-compose, translate, triage, chat) for the Thunderbird MailExtension `claw-mail-ai`.
summary.zh_CN: 为 Thunderbird claw-mail-ai 扩展提供的 AI 助手(摘要、智能回复、智能撰写、翻译、分类、邮箱对话)。

label.en: Summarize an email body into a one-line summary, key points, and action items

why.en: Send the email body to a model and get back a structured summary.
Remember the email summary so the agent can recall it later.

label.en: Generate three reply suggestions (formal / casual / short) for an email thread

why.en: Send the thread context to a model and get back three reply drafts.

label.en: Continue or complete a draft from a brief intent (e.g. 'decline politely')

why.en: Send the intent and current draft to a model and get back a completion.

label.en: Translate email text into a target language

why.en: Send the source text and target language to a model for translation.

label.en: Classify an incoming email into a category and propose tags

why.en: Send the sender / subject / snippet to a model and get back a category + tags.
Remember high-priority triage decisions so the agent can recall what mattered.

label.en: Answer a question grounded in supplied email context ('chat with your mailbox')

why.en: Send the question and surrounding messages to a model for a grounded answer.
